scope: Inherited DeerFlow2.1.0 versus Onyx4.8.3 comparison, with fixed GPTR3.7.0 as a matched baseline; source-only proposals do not decide the winner

task_selection.rule: Eight lowest SHA256(seed_utf8 + decimal idx) from the pinned132-row question pool. This small bilingual sample is not domain/language-balanced.
task_selection.worker_view: Exact top-level prompt bytes plus one common frozen output contract only; content.rubric and content.blocked are grader-only.

proposed_execution.order: Pinned question order; cycle GPTR/DeerFlow/Onyx, DeerFlow/Onyx/GPTR, Onyx/GPTR/DeerFlow by question index; reverse for repeat2.
proposed_execution.fresh_state: One fresh native thread/session/index scope per attempt, identical public-source access rules and same frozen search/fetch services across arms.
proposed_execution.quota_rule: First quota/429 suspends all arms and records the partial block; no silent effort/model downgrade or independent retry.
proposed_execution.source_policy: Preserve each question's original time constraints. Bind an observation cutoff, archived/versioned eligibility where the prompt requires historical availability, URL/time/content hashes and fetch failures. Neither a current page nor a judge verdict proves historical availability.
proposed_execution.compression: off control; gateway token conditions require a separate reviewed amendment on the same task/source snapshots
proposed_execution.window: Exclusive architecture-owned throwaway GPT-pool window coordinated with session0c and client-token/GPU trials

proposed_evaluation.citation_quality: A blinded upstream promptfoo model grader evaluates each report against independently retained numbered source passages and the frozen strict support/attribution rubric. Missing/unavailable evidence, wrong citation attribution, failed temporal eligibility or any unsupported material factual claim fails the report. Exact rubric, source mapping/transport and negative controls must be bound before freeze.
proposed_evaluation.rubric_quality: Retain the unchanged official DRB-II report-rubric grader separately. Its report-text evidence is not source entailment; its score is never substituted for citation support.
proposed_evaluation.decision_rule: A challenger replaces the matched GPTR baseline only with no lower strict-supported report success count on any question, no lower official rubric score per question, and at least one strict quality improvement. With identical quality on every question, require at least5% lower paired median gross input-plus-output tokens with complete same-scope native usage and no greater paired median agent time. For two eligible challengers use strict-supported report count, then official rubric score, then paired median gross tokens, then agent time. Otherwise preserve the measured baseline and report sampled failures/incomparability explicitly.
proposed_evaluation.limitations: No claim-level calibrated percentage, universal quality or statistical superiority follows this eight-question screen. A promptfoo rubric is a configured upstream scorer; a proposed rubric has not yet passed its negative controls.

required_before_freeze: Astra/max consequential read and Claude-lane read of finalized source/task/rubric/route/extension contract, exact accepted head/hash and freeze receipt
Allocated native host/project/window, installed GPTR/DeerFlow entrypoints and separately scoped Onyx-Lite provisioning with immutable service/image pins
Same source-backed keyless search/fetch service pins, exact engine/language/result-count/quotas, common output contract and automated clarification-off setting
Exact org-owned extension/plugin/skill/MCP inventory and useful loader activation checks: GPTR plugin executable/Python-version contract; DeerFlow0.2 extensions; Onyx research/sandbox tools
Native configured OmniRoute build/carry and actual all-call effort across main/child/summary/title/auxiliary calls; preserve differing native/API effort semantics
Source-backed evaluator/judge transport and frozen strict rubric; wrong-source, wrong-attribution, unsupported-claim, missing-source and temporal-violation negative controls before candidate outputs
Observable all-call native usage and enforced time/token/search/fetch bounds, terminal results and independent actual report/source observations
Exact independent archive/availability rules and blinded source/report/rubric bindings; all failed attempts and unknown counters retained
failures_preserved: The first prompt-hash probe looked inside content instead of the top-level prompt field and returned eight empty-string hashes. Those hashes are invalid; the corrected top-level probe asserts nonempty UTF8 prompts and supplies the bindings above.

The inherited source report used Sol max and proposed DeepEval citation scoring. This separate user-directed ultra study uses the requested upstream evaluator family, with source/quality transport qualification still open.
